After these things, Moses and Aaron entered,
“Thus says the Lord God of Israel:
Dimitte populum meum ut sacrificet mihi in deserto.
Release my people, so that they may sacrifice to me in the desert.”

ut eamus viam trium dierum in solitudinem,
so that we may go three days’ journey into the wilderness and sacrifice to the Lord our God.

The king of Egypt said to them:
Quare Moyses et Aaron sollicitatis populum ab operibus suis?
“Why do you, Moses and Aaron, distract the people from their works?
“The people of the land are many.
You see that the turmoil has increased:
quanto magis si dederitis eis requiem ab operibus?
how much more if you give them rest from the works?”
Præcepit ergo in die illo præfectis operum et exactoribus populi, dicens:
Therefore, on the same day, he instructed the overseers of the works, and the taskmasters of the people, saying:
Nequaquam ultra dabitis paleas populo ad conficiendos lateres,
“You shall no longer give chaff to the people to form bricks,
Et mensuram laterum, quam prius faciebant, imponetis super eos,
And you shall impose upon them the same quota of bricks that they made before.
for they are idle, and therefore they cry out,
‘We shall go and sacrifice to our God.’
They shall be oppressed with works,
so that they may not agree to lying words.”
Igitur egressi præfecti operum et exactores ad populum, dixerunt:
And so the overseers of the works and the taskmasters went out and said to the people:
and collect it wherever you are able to find it.
nec minuetur quidquam de opere vestro.
Neither will anything of your work be diminished.”
Dispersusque est populus per omnem terram Ægypti ad colligendas paleas.
And the people were dispersed through all the land of Egypt, in order to gather straw.
Likewise, the overseers of the works pressured them,
ut prius facere solebatis quando dabantur vobis paleæ.
just as you were accustomed to do before, when straw was given to you.”
Flagellatique sunt qui præerant operibus filiorum Israël,
And those who were first in the works of the sons of Israel were scourged by Pharaoh’s taskmasters,
“Why have you not filled the quota of bricks,
Quare non impletis mensuram laterum sicut prius,
And the first among the sons of Israel came,
et vociferati sunt ad Pharaonem dicentes:
and they cried out to Pharaoh, saying:
Cur ita agis contra servos tuos?
“Why do act against your servants in this way?
Straw is not given to us,
and yet the same amount of bricks is commanded.
So we, your servants, are cut up by scourging,
et injuste agitur contra populum tuum.
and injustice is done against your people.”
And for this reason you say,
Straw will not be given to you,
and you will return the customary number of bricks.”
Videbantque se præpositi filiorum Israël in malo,
And the first among the sons of Israel saw themselves in a crisis,
because it was said to them,
Non minuetur quidquam de lateribus per singulos dies.
“Nothing at all will be lessened from the bricks throughout each day.”
